{{Quote|General, I do believe you owe me an apology.''"<br />"''What I owe you, Lieutenant Veers, is a court martial for disobeying my direct&hellip;|Lieutenant Maximilian Veers and General Irrv, with the latter's speech cut short by a blaster-shot from Commander Grath|<ref name="Prom" />}}
The '''insurrection on Culroon III''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] when the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Culroon]] ambushed the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]], the Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] was charged with occupying Culroon III and planned to do so peacefully in a formal ceremony with the Culroon ruler [[Kloff]]. The plan was decried by [[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], who believed that the Culroon would not accept Imperial rule without violence. As a result, Veers was confined to the Imperial [[Imperial garrison (Culroon III)|base]] on the planet during the ceremony, commanding a single [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].

The ceremony was attended by the Imperial staff, a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], Kloff, and a dozen Culroon [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]]. Secretly, thousands more Culroon surrounded the site. The insurrection began when Kloff received a ceremonial [[Naval sword]] from General Irrv, which the Culroon used to stab the Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jeffers]]. The Culroon warriors then ambushed the stormtroopers, who were equipped with ceremonial [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and unable to maintain an effective defense. The Imperial forces were saved by Veers, who ignored his orders to stay at the base and marched the AT-AT towards the ceremony site. After Veers [[Death/Legends|killed]] many of the Culroon and the survivors fled, General Irrv began to threaten Veers with a [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]] for his disobedience until he was shot dead by [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commander]] [[Grath (stormtrooper commander)|Grath]]. The [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] gave Veers a battlefield promotion to [[Major/Legends|major]] for his heroism.

==Prelude==
===Target: Culroon III===
[[File:Planet10-SWR.png|thumb|right|300px|Culroon III (pictured) was targeted for Imperial subjugation.]]
The history of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Culroon III/Legends|Culroon III]] was filled with various [[Culroon wars|wars]] among<ref name="Prom" /> the tribes<ref name="Fact File 31">{{FactFile|31|VEE 1-2|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref> of the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Culroon]] until offworld [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] were imported and used by the Culroon<ref name="Prom" /> [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]<ref name="Fact File 31" /> [[Kloff]] to end the wars and unite the planet as its ruler. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was aware of Culroon III,<ref name="Prom" /> but due to the wars<ref name="Fact File 31" /> the planet was ignored until<ref name="Prom" /> the Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Between that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] to subjugate the planet using whatever means necessary.<ref name="Prom" /> The [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] orders came as standard Imperial policy involving the subjugation of worlds, as Culroon III had little to offer in terms of strategic positioning or resources. The Empire began Culroon III's occupation by building a [[Imperial garrison (Culroon III)|garrison]] on the planet in Kloff's territory.<ref name="Fact File 31" />

[[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]]<ref name="Prom" />&mdash;who had been deliberately transferred to a remote world by superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who considered him dangerous to their careers<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>&mdash;arrived with an initial research team while the Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was built<ref name="Prom" /> over the course of several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. Veers' role was to protect the Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] with an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] and an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], alongside<ref name="Fact File 31" /> a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] under [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Grath (stormtrooper commander)|Grath]]. In that [[time]], Veers learned about the history of the Culroon and believed that a peaceful surrender was out of character for them.<ref name="Prom" />

===A failed ceremony===
{{Quote|We might attain this planet with a show of force and by spilling a little Culroon blood, but not with a hollow ceremony.''"<br />"''Nonsense, Lieutenant! Your Academy training has made you a tad bloodthirsty, that's all. One more word Veers, and I'll have you riding a dewback on Tatooine!|Junior Lieutenant Maximilian Veers and General Irrv|<ref name="Prom" />}}
[[File:Veers_targets.png|thumb|left|300px|Maximilian Veers, who correctly predicted that the Culroon would not peacefully submit to Imperial rule]]
General Irrv sought to understand and work with the Culroon,<ref name="Starships">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|4|Welcome On Board}}</ref> therefore planning to conduct a formal ceremony with Kloff<ref name="Prom" /> involving the exchange of a ceremonial [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]<ref name="Fact File 31" /> and a [[Naval sword]]<ref name="Prom" /> to symbolize the peaceful transition of power. At a staff meeting, Veers scoffed at the plan, unaware that it had been the general's idea,<ref name="Fact File 31" /> and argued with Irrv that the Empire should attack the Culroon to demonstrate their authority forcefully as opposed to holding the ceremony. Irrv dismissed Veers' concerns as a sign of [[Blood/Legends|bloodlust]] resulting from his [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] training and threatened to reassign Veers to [[Dewback trooper/Legends|riding]] a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] on<ref name="Prom" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] if he persisted with his protests. Irrv then gave Veers a demerit, and confined him to the Imperial base for the duration of the occupation.<ref name="Prom" />

At the ceremony, Veers was given command of a single AT-AT, along with a [[Vehicle Command Crewer|pilot]] and a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="Prom" /> They were forced to run non-essential maintenance<ref name="Fact File 31" /> with the help of [[B-3Z technical droid]]s. The lieutenant watched the proceedings from a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] docking platform above the vehicle located less than ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the ceremony site. The Imperial garrison had two other AT-ATs that were on patrol miles away. At the ceremonial site, Irrv stood with a dozen [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]&mdash;including his [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jeffers]]&mdash;all in [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial dress uniform]]. They were accompanied by a legion of stormtroopers<ref name="Prom" /> equipped with underpowered and cumbersome dress-weapons<ref name="Fact File 31" /> designed for show rather than for combat. Kloff attended the ceremony with a dozen<ref name="Prom" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Fact File 31" /> Culroon [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] in ceremonial [[Clothing/Legends|dress]]. As the ceremony began, Veers observed it through a set of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], believing Irrv to be a fool for following through with his plan. He also noticed that Kloff had not brought the majority of his warriors to the ceremony and suspected that the warlord was plotting something. Secretly, thousands of Culroon warriors surrounded the site, wielding power weapons.<ref name="Prom" />

==The insurrection==
[[File:ATAT-SWFB.png|thumb|right|300px|An AT-AT (pictured) saved the Imperial forces during the insurrection.]]
The insurrection began when General Irrv presented Kloff with the Naval [[Sword/Legends|sword]], which the Culroon used to calmly stab Colonel Jeffers. The Culroon warriors revealed themselves and surrounded the Imperials at the ceremony. Immediately reacting to the ambush, Veers dropped his [[Binoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] and barked orders at his subordinates to quickly activate the AT-AT.<ref name="Prom" /> They marched the [[Walker/Legends|walker]] through the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]<ref name="Fact File 31" /> to the ceremony site, even though Veers knew that he risked a [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martial]] for leaving the garrison. Irrv gave orders for the stormtroopers to form a protective circle around him, and many of them were [[Death/Legends|killed]] as their ceremonial weapons were unable to match the Culroon's blaster power.<ref name="Prom" />

Kloff's warriors were able to wear down the stormtroopers,<ref name="Prom" /> intending to reach the general and abduct him.<ref name="Starships" /> Just as Kloff shouted for them to continue the attack, Veers' AT-AT shook the ground as it arrived and flattened [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and [[Bush/Legends|bushes]]. Many of the Culroon panicked and fled at the site of the AT-AT, believing it to be a giant monster. Veers directed the walker's blasterfire to clear the area around the stormtroopers. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Grath directed the surviving stormtroopers to rally beneath the AT-AT and use its legs as cover. The remaining Culroon warriors realized that their blasters were unable to pierce the AT-AT's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and fled. Veers ordered his gunner to fire on warriors as they retreated. Afterward, Veers smiled down at Irrv from the [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]]<ref name="Prom" /> and arrogantly<ref name="Fact File 31" /> requested an apology. Irrv began to reprimand Veers and was about to enact a court-martial before he was gunned down by<ref name="Prom" /> the superior officer on Culroon III,<ref name="CSWE Irrv">{{CSWECite|2|117|Irrv, General}}</ref> Grath,<ref name="Prom" /> for his perceived foolishness.<ref name="Fact File 45">{{FactFile|45|VEE 3-4|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Major Veers, you'll be good enough to escort us back to the garrison?''"<br />"''Of course, sir. But would you prefer to ride?|Commander Grath and Lieutenant Veers, after the former executed General Irrv|<ref name="Prom" />}}
Grath stepped over Irrv's corpse,<ref name="Fact File 45" /> [[Holster/Legends|holstered]] his blaster, and asked Veers for an escort back to the garrison, addressing him as "Major Veers"<ref name="Prom" /> as a reward for his heroism.<ref name="Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Veers appreciated the outcome and offered Grath a ride inside the AT-AT instead.<ref name="Prom" /> The newly promoted [[Major/Legends|major]] was subsequently posted to<ref name="Fact File 45" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="Fact File 45" /> and his actions during the insurrection brought him to the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who facilitated Veer's transition into [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] the ground forces of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], Vader's personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] group.<ref name="Starships" /> Veers continued to rise in [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] until he became a general<ref name="Galaxy Guide 3" /> at Vader's initiative.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Starwarssourcebook1st.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The insurrection on Culroon III first appeared in "The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers," published in ''The Star Wars Sourcebook''.]]
The insurrection on Culroon III first appeared in the short story "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]," published in [[1987]] in [[West End Games]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Prom" /> It was first identified in Veers' [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]], published by [[2001]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|generalmaximilianveers|Veers, General Maximilian}}</ref> In the short story, Veers watches the beginning of the ceremony from a shuttle docking platform above the AT-AT, and although it is not explicitly stated in the prose, would have had to move into the AT-AT's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] to participate in the counterattack.<ref name="Prom" /> The [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 31|thirty-first issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'' magazine,<ref name="Fact File 31" /> written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and published around [[July 31]], [[2002]],<ref name="FF Date">{{FFdates|31}}</ref> states that Veers observed the ceremony and ambush from the AT-AT cockpit.<ref name="Fact File 31" />

The short story also describes General Irrv giving Kloff the Naval sword that he uses to stab Colonel Jeffers,<ref name="Prom" /> whereas the ''Fact File'' states that Kloff was meant to present the sword to Irrv when he used it to attack Jeffers instead.<ref name="Fact File 31" /> The contradiction was repeated in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 14|fourteenth issue]] of the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|revised run]] of ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'',<ref name="Fact File 14">{{FactFile2014|14|VEE 1-4|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref> which was published on [[April 9]], [[2014]].<ref name="Fact File 14 Date">{{FactFile2014Dates|14}}</ref> This article follows the short story's version of events.
